name: Make-Up Lab
bio:
*** YOU MUST BE LOGGED INTO YOUR ACCOUNT FOR EVENTS TO BE VISIBLE***

Make-Up Lab is available for League students enrolled in a regular weekly class who have reported an absence (by email or phone call) or cancelled through the Parent Portal before a missed class has begun. The lab provides an opportunity for students to catch up on missed work. A League teacher is present at all times to provide assistance. Please sign up for 1 Make-Up Lab per missed class. Space is limited - reservations are required.

Please cancel online, or notify us if you are unable to attend. Frequently, there is a waiting list.

*Level tests may not be taken at Make-Up Labs. Tests can ONLY be taken during regular weekly classes.*
